summary: PolyPid Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held on July 15, 2026, where shareholders approved routine proposals: re-election of auditors and eight directors, compensation amendments, and an option grant for the CEO. The filing also notes a board-approved increase in the share option plan pool by 1,500,000 ordinary shares. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present.
